children: The IIM Bangalore alumnus moves to Arvind after 9.5 years at JK Maini, where he led key strategic initiatives
Himanshu Singh has joined Arvind Limited as Vice President – Strategy, marking a new chapter in his career after nearly a decade with the JK Maini Group.

Singh spent 9.5 years at JK Maini, where his responsibilities spanned corporate strategy, finance, fundraising, setting up manufacturing facilities, mergers and acquisitions, and the strategic sale of the business to Raymond. He also played a key role in building the group’s aerospace business, which he said grew 14-fold during his tenure.
Announcing the move on LinkedIn, Singh expressed gratitude for his journey at JK Maini and the opportunities to lead significant business initiatives.

An alumnus of the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore, where he completed his postgraduate management studies between 2014 and 2016, Singh brings experience across strategy, finance and business growth to his new role at Arvind.
Headquartered in Ahmedabad, Arvind Limited is a diversified textile and materials company with interests spanning textiles, apparel, advanced materials and environmental solutions.
